value.rationale: The optimal worst-case amplification of edge variation by finite reflecting heat flows is a directly motivated stability invariant. The theorem identifies the exact all-size/all-time constant, sharply localizes worst-case edges, quantifies strict finite-size suppression, and yields a universal optimal time-scale constant plus diffusive limit. These conclusions are not mere reparametrizations of a known eigenvalue table or nonsharp heat estimate.
